Package index

Trees

Build a tree from the taxonomy, attach it to a ‘phyloseq’ object and agglomerate taxa along it.

add_tree_pq()
Attach, repair and prune a phylogenetic tree onto a phyloseq object
phylo_glom_pq()
Agglomerate taxa closer than a cophenetic distance threshold
phylo_glom_scan_pq()
Scan several cophenetic thresholds before agglomerating
taxo2tree()
Convert taxonomy dataframe to phylogenetic tree

Species delimitation and clustering

Regroup taxa by a barcode gap (ABGD, ASAP) or by a sequence-similarity network (NSC).

delim_multi_pq()
Compare several species delimitations of a phyloseq object
delim_pq()
Species delimitation of a phyloseq object with ABGD or ASAP
ssn_glom_pq()
Agglomerate taxa into network sequence clusters (NSC)
ssn_glom_scan_pq()
Scan several similarity thresholds before agglomerating

Phylogenetic placement

Place reference sequences on a fixed reference phylogeny with EPA-ng and turn the placement into a taxonomy with gappa.

assign_placement_pq()
Assign a taxonomy from a phylogenetic placement
place_pq()
Place the reference sequences of a phyloseq object on a reference tree
print(<phylopq_refpkg>)
Print a reference package
ref_package_pq()
Assemble a reference package for phylogenetic placement

External programs

Check for and install the command-line programs the functions above drive.

install_abgd()
Install the ABGD species-delimitation program
install_asap()
Install the ASAP species-delimitation program
install_epang()
Install the EPA-ng phylogenetic placement program
install_gappa()
Install the gappa placement-analysis program
is_delim_installed()
Is an ABGD or ASAP executable available?
is_epang_installed()
Is EPA-ng available?
is_gappa_installed()
Is gappa available?

Re-exported from MiscMetabar

Alignment helpers that live in MiscMetabar so that every pqverse package can reach them, and are re-exported here.

reexports align_pq is_mafft_installed
Objects re-exported from MiscMetabar
